title: The Gemini supermoon
caption: tuesday's full moon in gemini is a supermoon, and gemini is the sign of conversation. notice the sentence you keep swallowing, say it without the haha, then listen
sources: Full Moon Nov 24, 2026, 6:53 am PT (14:53 UTC) at 2°20' Gemini — https://chani.com/this-year/key-dates/2026-astrological-key-dates-new-and-full-moons
Full moon = Sun and Moon on opposite sides of Earth (Sun in Sagittarius, Moon in Gemini); Gemini = the twins, ruled by Mercury (communication).

scenes.label: NOVEMBER 24 · SUPERMOON
lines: The full moon in *Gemini* is Tuesday,
and it's a *supermoon.*
Here's what to say, and to *whom.*

scenes.label: SUN ☉ · EARTH · MOON ☽
lines: A full moon is the sun and moon
on *opposite* sides of Earth,
so the whole face is *lit.*

scenes.label: GEMINI · THE TWINS
lines: Gemini is the *twins,* the sign of talking.
So this moon lights up what you *haven't said.*

scenes.label: THE NIGHT BEFORE
lines: Step one: *notice.*
Write the sentence you keep swallowing.
I like you. I'm hurt. I want *more.*

scenes.label: ONE SENTENCE · NO HAHA
lines: Step two: *say* it.
One sentence, to them, before Wednesday,
and don't soften it with a *haha.*
Delete it. Then *send.*

scenes.label: THE ALIGN APP
lines: Step three: *listen.*
Ask, then let the quiet do the work.
It's why talk cards on the Align app
hide your answer until you've *both* answered.

scenes.label: UNDER THE FULL MOON
lines: Hear what they say,
and what they *don't.*
Notice. Say. *Listen.*
The moon is full.
*Say it.*
